newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly down.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly down.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Monday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover rose to 2.798 billion yuan from 1.428 billion yuan last Friday with the 30-day contract the most active.
Traders said the re-opening of the domestic A share markets on Monday after the two-week lunar new year holiday pushed up both demand and volumes sharply.
Short-term financial centres, money brokerages run by the central bank, were major net sellers in order to lend money to securities firms, they said.

"The short-term financial centres, which used to be major buyers, have become active sellers since the central government's ban (in January) on state banks trading on the state debt secondary markets," one trader said.
